title: Great tour guide
text:
Our tour guide to Sagrada Família was Paula.  She has made our trip there unforgettable! Her deep knowledge of Gaudí’s work was impressive.  She explained the history, symbolism, and architectural details clearly. She is warm, friendly and humorous.

She was professional and approachable, answering all our questions with patience.  

Overall, the tour was educational, entertaining, and enjoyable, Paula is the perfect choice. Thank you for an amazing experience!
